title: Sable Offshore Corp. Prices Offerings of Common Stock and Convertible Senior Notes
summary: Sable Offshore Corp. (New York Stock Exchange: SOC) today announced the pricing of its concurrent public offerings of 32,467,533 shares of common stock, at a public offering price of $3.08 per share, and $300.0 million aggregate principal amount of 6.5% convertible senior notes due 2031 (the “notes”). The issuance and sale of the common stock and the notes are scheduled to settle on July 2, 2026, subject to customary closing conditions. Sable also granted the underwriters of the common stock offering a 30-day option to purchase up to an additional 4,870,129 shares of common stock solely to cover over-allotments, and granted the underwriters of the notes offering a 30-day option to purchase up to an additional $45.0 million aggregate principal amount of notes solely to cover over-allotments.
